correctness.rationale: The package derives the same normalized section/projection product as the source and differentiates its equally spaced perturbation. The projection-distance term contributes \(n(n-1)/12\); the section term is the absolute first moment of a centered Irwin–Hall sum. I independently recomputed the exact values for \(2\le n\le13\): the derivatives are \(-1/3,-1/2,-5/8,-2/3,-239/384,-29/60,-5629/23040,25/252,\ldots\), so the sign flips exactly between 8 and 9. For \(d\ge13\), Cauchy–Schwarz gives \(A_d\le\sqrt{d/12}<d/12\), proving positivity thereafter. Thus the finite exact check plus the analytic tail covers every dimension.

final_claim: For the direct equally spaced splitting path in dimension \(n\ge2\), the normalized reverse-projection first variation is \(n((n-1)/12-A_{n-1})\), where \(A_d=\mathbf E|\sum_{i=1}^d U_i|\) for iid \(U_i\sim\mathrm{Unif}[-1/2,1/2]\); it is negative for \(2\le n\le8\) and positive for every \(n\ge9\).
